I went to a high school that specialized in more individualized education, catering to each person's needs more than expecting everyone to conform to mass education.  

There was a kid with Autism, Asperbergers or Williams syndrome.  Can't remember which.  Anyway he got caught jerking it in the bathroom.  Now this is all fine and good and he should be told "hey don't do this", but for some reason I guess because news spread around the high school that this may have happened, my principal decided to bring him up in front of the high school and smash the rumors right there, calling him out and addressing it.  I would be mortified, but he exclaimed "WHAT WOULD YOU DO IF YOU WERE ME?!" to which the answer was easy - jerk it in the bathroom.

Fun fact - he also yelled at some of my teachers (who granted, were louder than necessary) by telling them to TURN DOWN THE DECIBELS!
